blind.description: A small human skull sculpture with a thick, melting candle fused directly onto the top of the cranium. The candle has wax drips flowing down over the brow and skull, and a short burnt black wick sticking up at the center. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and clean without floating fragments or mesh defects. Underside sits directly on the floor without an added plinth or base. Colored in aged tan/brown bone tones with pale yellowish wax and a dark wick; unlit with no active flame.
blind.from_above: A rounded circular object resembling a tart, flower, or pleated candle top with a dark center wick, slightly offset over the rounded back of the skull.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 8 to 10 inches tall and wide, reaching only ankle height next to the 5 ft 9 in figure.

notes: Candle is melted down and shorter than catalog height ratio, but reads clearly as a skull candle
